title: Explain related reviews as a derived code relationship
preconditions: Documentation records and review Items have current code evidence with both matching and nonmatching changes.

steps.action: Open a feature, story, or criterion that shares changed code with a review.
steps.expected_result: The page lists the matching review and labels the relationship as derived from code links.

steps.action: Inspect documentation whose code does not intersect a review.
steps.expected_result: Unrelated reviews are absent and the empty state still explains how related reviews are derived.

expected_result: Pass when related reviews are computed from current code intersections and labeled derived; fail on unrelated, unlabeled, or manually implied review links.
